summary: Batch #35 — Home tasks_done_today + kids' chores done_by + Helper in-portal Notifications + Calendar revamp + 'Love This Week' removal. BACKEND: 8/8 pytest pass in ~4.4s (new file /app/backend/tests/test_batch35_home_and_helper_notifs.py). Covered: (1) GET /api/home 'tasks' regression — still returns OPEN family task list as expected after the helpers-loop `tasks` shadowing fix; new 'tasks_done_today[]' array present with each item shape {item_id, title, priority, assignee, scope, done=True, done_by=<member card {member_id,name,...}>, done_at}. (2) POST /todos/items/{id}/toggle round-trip — creating a fresh task, toggling to done records done_by_member_id + done_at (verified in response body), the item disappears from /home.tasks AND appears in /home.tasks_done_today with the correct done_by card + done_at; un-toggle clears BOTH done_by_member_id AND done_at, item returns to /home.tasks. (3) POST /chores/{id}/complete on an existing kid chore records completed_by_member_id (the acting parent user) and /api/home kids[].chores[] surfaces done_by member card; /chores/{id}/uncomplete clears done_by back to None. (4) GET /helper/notifications shape — {items[], unread, last_read}; items are sorted newest-first, every item has emoji/title/subtitle/route/created_at; freshly seeded parent 1:1 chat + care-team message + parent handover all appear with correct kind/title/subtitle. (5) POST /helper/notifications/read zeros unread on subsequent GET AND on /helper/dashboard.notif_unread. (6) SECURITY — a db.messages (Family Chat) row seeded directly into Mongo does NOT appear in /helper/notifications (verified by scanning subtitles/titles for the unique marker). (7) A helper WITHOUT chat permission calling /helper/notifications receives NO 'chat' and NO 'care_team' kinds; handover items still surface for them. FRONTEND (Playwright mobile 390x844): Home — 'Family tasks' summary line '0 done · 7 to do' renders correctly (no completed tasks today for that fresh session; the strikethrough 'COMPLETED TODAY' subsection with home-task-done-<id> rows is wired in code at index.tsx:656 and gated on tasks_done_today.length > 0). home-chore-<id> chips present. Calendar revamp — gradient hero header shows year '2026' + month name + prev/Today/next arrows; horizontal member avatar row renders 5 members (cal-member-* x5); month grid renders 42 day cells (day-YYYY-MM-DD x42); each day cell shows event PILLS (Football, School, Doctor Appointment, Swimming, Grandma..., Family...); tapping a member avatar filters the grid (verified — Football + Grandma + Family remain, others disappear); tapping day-2026-07-26 updates the agenda header to 'Sunday, 26 July' with 'Nothing planned. Tap + to add an event.'; selected day 18 Aug shows a red count badge '1' beside the agenda title + the Doctor Appointment event with 'Waiting on Anaya, Priya' RSVP status pills and the Remind button (rsvp-nudge). fab-create-event visible. Family tab — 'Love This Week' section fully REMOVED (no matches in DOM or family.tsx source); 'Send Some Love' card retained. Helper portal (sunita/1234) — header bell (helper-notif-btn) visible; helper-notif-badge correctly NOT rendered when unread=0 (pytest had just marked read); tapping bell navigates to /helper-portal/notifications which lists 24 helper-notif-<i> alert rows including 'Raj sent you a message' (TEST_B35_CHAT_*), 'Raj · Care Team' (TEST_B35_CT_*, 🎤 Voice message, 📷 Photo), and 'Raj left a handover note' (TEST_B35_HANDOVER_*) — all seeded rows show up newest-first. After tapping the bell (backend auto-reads), returning to portal shows no helper-notif-badge — unread correctly cleared. Verdict: Batch #35 fully passes on backend + frontend. No new bugs.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:2894-2917 /api/home — clean split: tasks = OPEN todo_items (done:{$ne:true}) sorted by due_date; tasks_done_today = todo_items where done=true AND done_at >= today (UTC start), sorted by done_at desc, capped at 60. Each row exposes done_by via await _mcard(done_by_member_id). Nice.
server.py:2736-2749 toggle_todo_item — now_done branch stamps done_by_member_id=<acting user's member_id> AND done_at=now_iso(); un-toggle clears BOTH to None. Correct.

server.py:2372-2380 complete_chore — inserts chore_completions with completed_by_member_id=(mine or {}).get('member_id') or c['owner_member_id']; falls back to owner if the acting user has no member card. /api/home:2935 exposes _mcard(cc.completed_by_member_id) as chore.done_by.

server.py:6940-6997 _helper_notifications + /helper/notifications — feed strictly aggregates 4 helper-scoped collections: db.helper_messages (only sender='parent', chat-perm gated), db.care_team_messages (excluding this helper's own posts, chat-perm gated), db.helper_handovers (by='parent'), db.helper_ratings. db.messages (family chat) is INTENTIONALLY not queried — verified via injected TEST_B35_MSG probe: NOT surfaced. Sorted newest-first via ISO timestamp string sort. unread = count(created_at > helper_notifs_read_at). Route is clean.

server.py:7000-7004 /helper/notifications/read — updates helper_notifs_read_at=now_iso() on db.helpers doc. Subsequent GET recomputes unread=0. /helper/dashboard also uses _helper_notif_unread so the header badge clears in one round-trip.

frontend/app/helper-portal/index.tsx:284-289 — helper-notif-btn always rendered; helper-notif-badge conditionally rendered only when notif_unread>0 (data.notif_unread from GET /helper/dashboard). Nice conditional so DOM stays clean when read.
